content_zh:
少女唇角上扬，笑颜如花：“稍后，帮我告诉于蓉一声，我和她的帐，来日再算！”
四名轿夫都愣住了，等他们回过神来的时候，一阵轻风闪过，已经人去轿空，只有那微凉的夜风刺激着他们的神经……
白颜并不知，她的离开，在流火国引起了一阵轰动。
钱家没有接到人，自然去找于蓉算账，为了让钱家保密，于蓉不但没有收到聘礼，还赔偿了一大笔银子，让原本就恨着白颜的她，更是恨得牙痒痒。
比之于蓉，于老夫人更因此心痛。
一想到将要到手的三品丹药飞了，她心疼的当街嚎哭，于蓉急忙为自家老母亲开解，声称老母亲向来待白颜如亲外孙女，谁知白颜不告而别的与男人私奔了，老母亲出于担心与不舍才会嚎哭。
于是，于老夫人有情有义，白颜是一只白眼狼的消息，传荡在大街小巷。
一时间，白家之人名声大噪，就连于老夫人也被世人钦佩，唯独白颜一人，受万千唾骂。
白颜的离开，最受伤的无非是白潇，他将自己关在房内整整数月有余，等出来之后，原先青涩的少年却蜕变的很是成熟，一双眼睛已经没有了以往的清澈，反被冷漠所取代……
数月之后。
一座荒芜的山谷之内，白颜紧紧的捂着疼痛的肚子，额上冷汗滚滚落下，她咬着牙齿，挺身靠在了背后的岩石上。
“我预测的预产期应该还有两天，为何偏偏现在就要生了？”
现在这个地方，没有任何的生产工具，连一盆热水都没有……
“还好我之前准备了些丹药。”
她缓缓的呼出了一口气，拿出一枚丹药服了下去，当丹药入口的瞬间，她感受到之前丧失的力量在逐渐恢复……
“吱吱。”
不知何时，一群火狐从旁边围了过来。
白颜的心里很是紧张，本以为这些火狐会伤害她，谁知它们竟然只是将她围在中间保护起来，如同尽忠职守的护卫。
白颜看着这群火狐，眼底深思。
在大陆上，有普通的野兽，同样也存在着妖兽。

这些妖兽可以被人类驯化契约，作战所用，更有如同妖兽宗这种专门驯化妖兽的势力。
可让她没想到的是，这些火狐为何会想要护着她？
不，应该说，是想护着她的孩子！
不知道是不是丹药的作用，还是肚子中的孩子很想出来，这一次，白颜使劲一用力，一个软蠕蠕的东西就从体内滑了出来。
然而……
就在孩子出来的那一刻，那些原本围着她的火狐一瞬间向后退了几步，整齐的跪倒在地，爪子往前作揖，如同一群大臣在跪拜着他们的帝王。
更在白颜没有看到的地方，大陆上所有的妖兽都如同这些火狐统统跪了下来，朝着她所在的方向朝拜。
天降异象，万兽朝宗！
王者降世，天下归一！
白颜可不管外界的那些变化，她已经被面前的一幕吓傻了……

content_en:
The corners of the girl's lips raised, and she smiled like a flower: "Later, please help me tell Yu Rong that we will settle the accounts with her one day!"
The four bearers were stunned. When they came to their senses, a gust of breeze flashed past, and the sedan was empty. Only the cool night breeze stimulated their nerves...
Bai Yan didn't know that her departure caused a sensation in Flowing Fire Country.
The Qian family didn't receive anyone, so they naturally went to settle the accounts with Yu Rong. In order to keep the Qian family secret, Yu Rong not only did not receive the betrothal gift, but also paid a large sum of money in compensation, which made her hate Bai Yan even more.
Compared to Yu Rong, Mrs. Yu was even more heartbroken by this.
When she thought that the third-grade elixir she was about to get was gone, she cried in distress in the street. Yu Rong hurriedly explained to his old mother, claiming that her old mother had always treated Bai Yan like her own granddaughter, but she didn't know that Bai Yan had eloped with a man without saying goodbye. The old mother cried out of worry and reluctance.
As a result, the news that Bai Yan was a white-eyed wolf spread in the streets.
For a time, the Bai family became famous, and even Mrs. Yu was admired by the world, but Bai Yan was the only one who was reviled by thousands of people.
Bai Yan's departure hurt Bai Xiao the most. He locked himself in the room for more than a few months. After he came out, the young boy who was originally young had transformed into a mature man. His eyes were no longer as clear as before, but were replaced by indifference...
A few months later.
In a deserted valley, Bai Yan clutched her painful stomach tightly, cold sweat rolled down her forehead. She gritted her teeth and leaned against the rock behind her.
"My predicted due date should be two days away. Why is it happening now?"
There are no production tools in this place now, not even a basin of hot water...
"Fortunately, I prepared some elixirs before."
She exhaled slowly, took out an elixir and drank it. The moment the elixir entered her mouth, she felt that the power she had lost before was gradually recovering...
"Zhizhi."
At some point, a group of firefoxes came around from the side.
Bai Yan was very nervous. She thought these fire foxes would hurt her, but unexpectedly they just surrounded her and protected her, like a loyal guard.
Bai Yan looked at the group of fire foxes with deep thought in her eyes.
On the continent, there are ordinary beasts, and there are also monster beasts.
These monster beasts can be domesticated and contracted by humans for use in combat, and there are even forces like the Monster Beast Sect that specialize in taming monster beasts.
But what she didn't expect was why these firefoxes wanted to protect her?
No, it should be said that she wanted to protect her child!
I don't know if it was the effect of the elixir, or the child in her belly wanted to come out, but this time, Bai Yan pushed hard, and a soft and squirmy thing slipped out of her body.
However...
The moment the child came out, the firefoxes that had been surrounding her took a few steps back, knelt down neatly on the ground, and bowed their paws forward, like a group of ministers kneeling before their emperor.
What Bai Yan didn't see was that all the monsters on the mainland knelt down like these fire foxes and worshiped in her direction.
A vision comes from the sky, and all beasts come to the sect!
The king comes to the world and the world is united!
Bai Yan didn't care about the changes in the outside world, she was already frightened by the scene in front of her...
